verdict.rationale: Zep's own product page hints at self-hosting via 'Your VPC' deployment (zep-docs-17), but there's no documentation of a Zep Docker image, self-host guide, or open-source repo for the core Zep service (users, threads, governance, zepctl). The only concretely open-source, locally-runnable component is Graphiti, the underlying temporal knowledge graph framework (zep-docs-15, zep-gh-1/2/3), which is a narrower engine, not the full 'memory layer' (threads, MCP server, governance, CLI) that Zep markets. Missing for 10: explicit Docker/self-host instructions for the full Zep platform, a public GitHub repo for Zep itself, and licensing details confirming open-source status of the complete memory layer.
